adopted.summary: Prerender the page's own render functions into viewer/dist at build; real paths for release notes; landing rebuilt around outputs, three install steps and permissions; funnel events to Clarity and GA behind one gate, plus Worker events over GA's Measurement Protocol
adopted.rationale:
- Reuses renderLanding / renderPost: no second template to drift
- Build fails on a blank or 'Loading…' #app: the failure the step exists for
- Real paths, because a fragment never reaches a crawler
- One SITE_ANALYTICS flag, so Clarity and GA cannot disagree
- Reload on entering a PR route, because Clarity's stop is unreliable
- Worker reports install and review steps: they happen without a browser
- Off unless GA_API_SECRET is set: the measurement id is public
- Counts and a pseudonym only: names never leave analytics.ts
- Pseudonym keyed by a Worker-only secret, not one Google receives
- Three install steps: the App alone yields 'No Intent Document'
- Permissions copy checked against GitHub's App record and worker source

tour.title: Prerender site pages into dist at build
tour.what:
- Adds `build/prerender.mjs`: runs index.html's own script in jsdom per route, writes #app into static copies under `viewer/dist/`
- Routes: `/`, `/blog/`, `/blog/<version>/`, `/installed/`
- Sets per-page title, description, canonical, OG and Twitter tags
- BlogPosting JSON-LD on posts, `<` escaped; FAQPage JSON-LD on `/` only; noindex on `/installed/`
- Generates `sitemap.xml` from RELEASES, no lastmod on `/`; hand-written sitemap deleted
- Fails the build on a script error, no h1, under 300 chars, or 'Loading…'
- Copies an explicit asset allowlist; `.assetsignore` deleted
- Wrangler serves `../viewer/dist`; `build:pages` joins the viewer build
tour.why:
- Live body was 'Loading…' without JS (curl-confirmed)
- Bing, LinkedIn, Slack and LLM crawlers mostly do not run scripts
- Allowlist replaces .assetsignore: DESIGN.md, src and configs no longer served
- Build date as lastmod would change on every deploy
tour.attention: whether the 25ms wait and 300-char floor catch a half-rendered page

tour.title: Release notes move from #/blog to real paths
tour.what:
- Replaces `parseBlogHash` with `parseBlogRoute` on `location.pathname`; `blogHref()` builds `/blog/<v>/`
- Redirects legacy `#/blog/<v>` links with `location.replace`
- `sitePage()` picks the page for both boot and the theme toggle's re-render
- Nav, logo, release rows, post nav and llms.txt link to real paths
- Saves the theme choice to localStorage; head script re-applies it before first paint
- Favicon and stylesheet hrefs become root-absolute
tour.why:
- Search engines never index past `#`, so release notes were invisible
- `#/blog` links are already out in the world
- Separate pages reset a theme held only on `<html>`; found in the Chrome run
tour.attention: theme persistence from / to /blog/<v>/ and on reload: no test output shown

tour.title: PR links hide the prerendered landing before first paint
tour.what:
- Head script sets `data-route="pr"` on `<html>` for a PR hash
- CSS hides every `[data-prerendered]` node under that flag
- `parseHash` now anchored (`^#owner/repo/pull/N`), same as `PR_ROUTE` in head
tour.why:
- PR links land on the same `/` document, which now carries the landing page
- Viewer replaces #app only after load, so the landing would show under every review link until then
- App posts `${origin}/#owner/repo/pull/N`, which the anchored pattern matches
tour.attention: a PR link on a slow connection: any landing content before the review renders?

tour.title: Hero and permissions: what the App can access
tour.what:
- Rewrites hero copy: guided review first, MCP server later
- Adds an access line under the install button, linking to `#permissions`
- Adds 'Permissions and data': a row per permission, sign-in token, what is kept, how to remove
- Webhook row: PR events acted on; installs, removals and repository changes only counted
- Usage counts: lists every Worker event; counts plus all/selected and PR action; keyed hash, not 'anonymous'
- `richHtml` sets code spans aside before emphasis, so `intent-*.md` keeps its `*`
- Footer: documents fetched per request and passed through, not 'read live in your browser'
tour.why:
- Page never listed permissions, PR writes, or uninstall steps
- Hero supporting copy led with 'MCP server' and 'session'
- Copy checked against GitHub's App record and worker source
- First draft predated the GA work: said 'pull request events only' and 'anonymous'
- Chrome run showed the uninstall globs losing their `*`
- Old footer claim was false: the Worker fetches with the reviewer's token
tour.attention: Usage counts line against webhook.ts outcome names and analytics.ts params; user never saw it

tour.title: What a reviewer gets: six labelled parts
tour.what:
- Adds `renderReviewerGets`: overview, assumptions, notes and open questions, walkthrough, coverage, verification
- Each part shows an excerpt from the example document (`SAMPLE`), copied as written
- 'Pick a stop' jumps to the demo panel (`id="demo"`)
tour.why:
- Checklist's labelled outcomes: right idea, wrong labels
- Claims stop at what the product checks: every hunk tied to a reason

tour.title: Three install steps and a post-install page
tour.what:
- `renderInstallSteps`: register MCP server, install App and pick repos, open a PR
- New `/installed/` page: heading per `setup_action` (install, request, update), MCP tabs, next step
- Head script strips `installation_id` from the address before any tag loads
tour.why:
- App alone puts 'No Intent Document' on every PR
- `/installed/` is meant as GitHub's Setup URL; not set yet, web UI only
- installation_id names an installation; nothing on the page uses it
tour.attention: nothing reaches /installed/ until the Setup URL is set; update only with 'Redirect on update'

tour.title: Site funnel events
tour.what:
- `track()` sends to Clarity (session tags) and GA (event params); no-op unless SITE_ANALYTICS
- Events: landing_view, release_notes_view, app_install_return, install_app_click, mcp_command_copy, mcpb_download
- Page-view events fire once per page load (`PAGE_TRACKED`), not on each hash change
- `installAppLink` tags the click by placement: hero vs install step
- `jumpLink` scrolls in-page without changing the hash
tour.why:
- Clarity had no events; the funnel was unreadable
- boot re-runs on back, forward and plain #anchors, inflating the first funnel step
- A hash change re-runs boot, rebuilding the page and restarting the demo
tour.attention: install_app_click fires as the page leaves for github.com: does the hit get out?

tour.title: One analytics gate: never on PR routes, only on reviewassist.dev
tour.what:
- Head script sets `SITE_ANALYTICS`: hostname is reviewassist.dev and route is not a PR
- Clarity and GA both load only under that flag; GA via script, not static `<script src>`
- On hashchange or popstate into a PR route: sets `ga-disable-<id>`, calls `clarity("stop")`, stops the event, reloads
tour.why:
- User: stop Clarity on PR pages; both tools record addresses unmasked
- A PR address names the repository and pull request
- Pasting a review link into an open site tab changes only the hash
- Clarity's stop is unreliable, hence the reload
- Public repo: without the hostname gate, self-hosted copies would report here
tour.attention: capture-phase listener must beat boot's hashchange handler; reloaded state never observed

tour.title: Worker funnel events over GA's Measurement Protocol
tour.what:
- New `analytics.ts`: `reportEvent` posts one event
- Sends nothing unless GA_API_SECRET and SESSION_SECRET are both set
- `installationEvent` maps install, uninstall and repository changes to counts
- client_id: HMAC-SHA256 of a labelled installation id, keyed by SESSION_SECRET
- `handleWebhook` accepts installation and installation_repositories after the signature check, answers 202
- `process()` ends with review_posted, review_no_document, or review_invalid_document (unparseable JSON)
- Adds GA_MEASUREMENT_ID var; vitest now runs worker tests
tour.why:
- Install, uninstall and review steps never touch the site
- User asked for GA; Analytics Engine has no funnel dashboard
- Measurement id is public; the secret is what a self-hosted copy lacks
- GA api_secret is in every hit URL; installation ids are sequential
- An unparseable document is a broken run, not a missing one
- Review event sent last, so it means the PR posts went through
tour.attention: docMissing is any non-OK fetch: a GitHub 403 or 5xx counts as review_no_document

tour.title: Release notes 1.0.1 to 1.0.5
tour.what:
- Adds five RELEASES entries: date, title, summary, body
- Each becomes a prerendered page and a sitemap entry
tour.why:
- List stopped at 1.0.0 though 1.0.5 had shipped
- Written from git log between tags and GitHub releases; private repo names left out
- 1.0.1 marked breaking: `problem.evolution` removed from a strict schema, checked against tagged schemas
tour.attention: figures (670 of 1,400s; 61 to 103 minutes; 89%) never checked against a source

tour.title: Demo scroll fixes carried in from uncommitted work
tour.what:
- `syncDemo`: demo runs only on screen, unhovered and in auto mode
- IntersectionObserver pauses it off screen; ignores a detached panel after re-render
- `lockDemoHeight` holds the panel at the tallest stop seen at this width
- `keepActiveStopInRail` scrolls only the rail, not the page
tour.why:
- Uncommitted before the session began; included because the user asked for one commit
- Neither authored nor specifically tested in this session
tour.attention: untested here: hidden demo restarting on a stale mouseleave; min-height after resize

tour.title: jsdom build dependency
tour.what:
- Adds jsdom ^25.0.1 as a viewer devDependency
- Lockfile gains jsdom and its transitive deps, all dev-only
tour.why: - prerender.mjs needs a DOM at build time

tour.title: Generated stylesheet, comments and labels

- Rewrites the FAQ JSON-LD comment for per-page metadata
- Renames the CI build step; command unchanged
- Updates the viewer package description
